estimand.name: paired_intervention_effect
estimand.outcome: pre_registered per-example utility; primary macro-F1 reconstructed from ledger
estimand.interpretation: effect of the named implementation under this fixed protocol, not universal causal effect

identification_requirements: same example_id is evaluated by treatment and control
treatment and control code versions are frozen before reading outcomes
no training or calibration row belongs to the S06 episode set
outcome definition and abstention utility are frozen before evaluation
all clusters and exclusions are reported
no claim beyond the fixed S06 protocol without a separate design
blocked_misinterpretations: paired difference is a universal treatment effect
episode bootstrap fixes an invalid or incomplete ledger
